agreements: Retire the unrun two-key v1 gateway and retain the two-root sixteen-key mirrored core.
Use four central fits, 128 target-masked items per adapter, success-filtered child-authored endpoints, and no D0, TEXT, GOLD, generic non-harm, or C11 machinery.
Limit any pass reading to seen-key structured endpoint-policy carriage under held renderings and four fixed spill families.
Both identity-, case-, surface-, and seed-disjoint roots under one shared frozen model and recipe must pass without pooling.
Repair the proposal before implementation ratification; concrete run bytes and hardware receipts remain for a later execution manifest.

disagreements.issue: Whether to retain an inferential lower-bound gate and how to avoid treating two modes of one tool as independent.

positions.position: Use a tool-cluster bootstrap or remove the confidence-bound gate and call the distribution descriptive.
Use a prospectively fixed stratified tool-cluster algorithm with exact seed/repetitions or exhaustive resampling.

resolution.rationale: Only eight selected tools are cluster units and exhaustive stratified resampling is cheap: 4^4 times 4^4 equals 65,536 ordered resamples.
resolution.selected_position: Use exhaustive stratified tool-cluster resampling, carrying both modes and all repeated observations with each tool.
resolution.required_change: Bind the exact one-sided lower-95-percent order-statistic convention and degeneracy handling in the successor; never resample sixteen keys independently.

disagreements.issue: Which mechanics must be fixed before implementation ratification versus deferred to the separate execution manifest.

positions.position: Fix every reducer-, estimand-, claim-, source-protocol-, visibility-, and total-budget semantic now; defer concrete identifiers, seeds, tokenizer receipts, paths, and throughput.
Also require extensive capability, atomicity, crash, and process-isolation detail before implementation.

resolution.rationale: The human directive requires simple scout hygiene and parks the full C11 guard. Scientific semantics and the authority boundary must be exact now, but concrete run bytes and heavyweight durability are unnecessary before source authoring.
resolution.selected_position: Fix semantic and reducer mechanics plus narrow CPU sentinels now; bind concrete run bytes and runtime receipts later; omit C11-grade hardening.
resolution.required_change: Create a newly hash-bound successor scope with corrected labels, metrics, denominators, source protocol, parser, workload formula, visibility roles, claim text, and minimal lifecycle/capability checks.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Both interpretations independently show an unreachable label and missing run-level reduction.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make structural interface failure, binding-with-spill, gateway-negative, and two-root pass mutually exclusive and reachable.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Metric and denominator choices can alter every central gate.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind exact ACT/DONE grammar, continuation likelihood, EOS, NLL, TV, signed emission, aggregation, denominator, and error rules.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Modes are clustered within tool and the pass permits four keys below the directional threshold.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use exhaustive stratified tool-cluster resampling and qualified aggregate/stratum plus 12-of-16 claim wording.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The proposed ceiling omitted a large fixed source and read workload.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind symbolic exact calls, turns, hard token caps, total inclusion, and a pre-source resource stop; concrete throughput waits for execution manifest.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The child/harness distinction and source-to-held stage boundary must be enforceable.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind two emissions per case, typed child-versus-harness access, no semantic retry, complement bijection/equal target lengths, mechanical surface registries, and post-commit held/oracle loading.

concern_dispositions.rationale: CPU implementation tests need narrow proof that forbidden execution hooks remain unreachable without importing C11 machinery.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add lazy imports and simple sentinels for model/tokenizer/trainer/device/network/subprocess/adapter-write paths; retain basic fail-if-exists and hash lifecycle checks.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Claim must reflect aggregate/stratum and 12-of-16 gates.
Symbolic total and pre-source stop belong in architecture; concrete telemetry belongs in manifest.

Add typed source roles, exact model-visible serialization, held-stage barrier, and target provenance checks.
Bind the two-emission source protocol, no-semantic-retry behavior, and canonical lowest ordering.

Make labels reachable, define exact likelihood/TV and exhaustive cluster uncertainty, and bind run-level reduction.
